source_rules: Reclassify all source type=corrente nodes by taxonomy.class, never just by their broad legacy type.
When taxonomy is absent, do not promote a historical movement, school or technique to genre without review.
Opera as a category for individual compositions is distinct from musical genre Opera.
Sonata as genre is not the formal sonata-form used within movements.
Grosso, solo concerto and concerto for multiple soloists are distinct; no inference that every double concerto is grosso.
A generic composer–genre link does not entail specific composer–work–genre links.
Preserve every original node and edge in the unified federation, with source metadata.
Media/library links belong to resource metadata not causal history.
Flaminio frozen until user instructs otherwise.
